generation.scope: There are exactly two index-preserving isomorphism classes with point-fiber point graph a smooth integral quintic disjoint from the finite residual. Both are realized, the residual is empty, the two point graphs are reduced elliptic quintics, and their bare period is one. Each has five folded central quartics, with a four-parameter normalization certified by the degree-sixteen cutoff. The canonical four-shift is projectively the identity.
